general.question: What makes your tech consulting different from competitors?
general.answer: We focus on specialized B2B services across 5 core service lines with deep expertise in each. Our team has 15+ years of enterprise experience, and we prioritize ROI and measurable results for every engagement. We're not generalists – we specialize.

general.question: Do you work with small businesses or only enterprises?
general.answer: We work with companies of all sizes – startups, SMBs, and enterprises. Our service tiers (Starter, Professional, Enterprise) are designed to scale with your business and budget.

general.question: What's your typical project timeline?
general.answer: Timelines vary by service: Website projects are 2-4 weeks, custom software 4-16 weeks, consulting 2-12 weeks. We'll provide a detailed timeline after understanding your requirements.

general.question: Do you provide support after project completion?
general.answer: Yes, absolutely. All our service tiers include post-project support. Lengths vary from 30 days (Starter) to 24/7 ongoing (Enterprise). We stand behind our work.

software.question: What technologies do you use for custom software development?
software.answer: We work with modern stacks: React/Next.js for web frontend, Node.js/Python for backend, React Native for mobile. We choose the best technology for your specific needs.

software.question: Can you handle legacy system modernization?
software.answer: Yes, legacy system modernization is one of our specialties. We can gradually migrate systems to modern architectures without disrupting operations.

software.question: Do you provide maintenance and updates after launch?
software.answer: Yes, all custom software includes a maintenance period. Extended support packages are available (monthly or retainer-based).

software.question: What about security in custom applications?
software.answer: Security is built into every application. We follow OWASP guidelines, implement encryption, secure authentication, and regular security audits.

hosting.question: What's your uptime guarantee?
hosting.answer: We offer 99% (Starter), 99.5% (Professional), and 99.9% SLA (Enterprise). If we miss our SLA, we provide service credits.

hosting.question: Can I scale my hosting as my traffic grows?
hosting.answer: Absolutely. Our infrastructure is designed to scale. You can upgrade anytime, and we handle the scaling seamlessly without downtime.

hosting.question: What about backups and disaster recovery?
hosting.answer: Backups are included in all plans. Enterprise plans include full disaster recovery with multiple geographic redundancy.

hosting.question: Do you support different technologies/frameworks?
hosting.answer: Yes, we support Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby, Java, and more. We can host any tech stack you're using.

hosting.question: How quickly can you set up hosting?
hosting.answer: Most hosting setups are live within 24 hours. Complex Enterprise setups may take 3-5 days.

consulting.question: How do you determine if consulting is right for us?
consulting.answer: We start with a free discovery call to understand your challenges and goals. We'll recommend the right service and level based on your needs.

consulting.question: What's the typical ROI from consulting engagements?
consulting.answer: ROI varies, but typical clients see 25-40% cost savings, 30-50% efficiency improvements, or significant revenue increases through transformation projects.

consulting.question: Can consulting help with compliance (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2)?
consulting.answer: Yes, compliance is one of our core consulting specialties. We help companies achieve and maintain GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and more.

consulting.question: How are consultant hours billed?
consulting.answer: We offer flexible engagement models: hourly rates ($150-200/hr), fixed project fees, or retainer arrangements. We'll discuss the best fit for your situation.

pricing.question: Are there setup fees or hidden costs?
pricing.answer: No hidden costs. Setup is typically free. All pricing is transparent – we'll show you exactly what you're paying for.

pricing.question: Can I start small and upgrade later?
pricing.answer: Yes, all our services are designed to scale. Start with Starter tier and upgrade to Professional or Enterprise as you grow.

pricing.question: Do you offer volume discounts for large implementations?
pricing.answer: Yes, volume discounts are available. Contact our sales team for custom quotes on large deployments.

pricing.question: What's your refund policy?
pricing.answer: Monthly services: 30-day money-back guarantee if not satisfied. Project-based: cancellation available with prorated credits.

pricing.question: Can I lock in pricing for multiple years?
pricing.answer: Yes, annual and multi-year commitments are available with discount (typically 10-20% savings).

support.question: What are your support hours?
support.answer: Starter: Business hours (8am-5pm). Professional: 24/5 (24hrs weekdays). Enterprise: 24/7 around the clock.

support.question: How quickly do you respond to support tickets?
support.answer: Starter: Within 24 hours. Professional: Within 4 hours. Enterprise: Within 1 hour. Critical incidents are responded to immediately.

support.question: Can I talk to a person or is support only via email/chat?
support.answer: All support includes phone, email, and chat. Enterprise customers have a dedicated account manager.

support.question: What if I need help outside my service hours?
support.answer: Enterprise customers: 24/7 support included. Professional: After-hours support available (additional fee). Starter: Emergency support available.

security.question: Is my data secure with you?
security.answer: Yes. We're ISO 27001 certified, SOC 2 Type II compliant, and GDPR-ready. Encryption, regular audits, and strict access controls are standard.

security.question: Where is my data stored?
security.answer: Data is stored in secure, redundant data centers. You can specify geographic location (US, EU, etc.) based on compliance requirements.

security.question: What about backup and disaster recovery?
security.answer: All plans include automated backups. Enterprise includes geographic redundancy and rapid recovery (RTO < 1 hour).

security.question: Do you conduct security audits?
security.answer: Yes, regular security audits are included in Professional and Enterprise plans. Penetration testing available on request.

connectivity.question: How fast is your internet service?
connectivity.answer: Starter: 50Mbps. Professional: 200Mbps. Enterprise: 1Gbps. Custom: Higher speeds available. All are dedicated, not shared.

connectivity.question: What about redundancy if your connection goes down?
connectivity.answer: We offer dual-redundant connections and automatic failover. Enterprise includes geographic diversity.

connectivity.question: Can you handle multi-location connectivity?
connectivity.answer: Yes, MPLS and SD-WAN networks can connect multiple locations securely and efficiently.

connectivity.question: How long does fiber deployment take?
connectivity.answer: Deployment timelines depend on location and distance. Small deployments: 1-3 weeks. Large projects: 2-8 weeks.

compliance.question: Are you GDPR compliant?
compliance.answer: Yes, fully GDPR compliant. We help customers implement GDPR-required controls and maintain compliance.

compliance.question: Do you support HIPAA compliance?
compliance.answer: Yes, HIPAA-ready infrastructure and consulting available for healthcare organizations.

compliance.question: Can you help with SOC 2 certification?
compliance.answer: Yes, SOC 2 Type II certified. We help customers prepare for audits and achieve their own certifications.

compliance.question: What about industry-specific compliance (PCI-DSS, etc.)?
compliance.answer: We support compliance with major frameworks: PCI-DSS (payments), HIPAA (healthcare), FERPA (education), and more.
